headline: Cirrus Logic advertises a Fall co-op for SV-RNM, user-defined types and audio ASIC verification
fact: Cirrus Logic's company account advertised a Fall 2026 Mixed Signal Modeling & Verification Engineer co-op in Austin on May 2. The preserved job description assigns top-down SystemVerilog model development and validation, AMS/UVM verification planning for audio-processing ASICs, behavioral models using SV-RNM, SystemVerilog user-defined types and Verilog-AMS, schematic abstraction, and regression and flow support. The advertised student placement lasts 12–14 weeks. The Event date is the employer's public announcement, not the Fall work term or an inferred first posting date.
